name: WordWorld new-command evaluation 2026-10-15
method: 50 new hand-authored commands and gold actions frozen before executing the parser. Author had access to implementation and development examples; not independently human-labeled or randomly sampled.
scope: 44 core commands plus 6 explicitly marked capability probes. Each command is parsed independently; pronoun probes contain their antecedents within the same command. Landmarks are assumed to exist; scene placement is not scored.
evaluation_kind: retest after parser development; not unseen-command accuracy

metric_definitions.exact_match: Complete ordered action dictionaries match, including all emitted fields; per command over all 50.
metric_definitions.intent: Ordered action-name sequence matches; per command over all 50. Does not validate entity or setting value.
metric_definitions.entity_count_color: Ordered (action, type, count, color) tuples for all typed actions match, per command over all 50. Pure setting/no-op cases contribute empty typed-action lists.
metric_definitions.spatial: Ordered (type, relation, target, targets) tuples for all typed actions match, on gold-spatial commands only. Extra subjects are penalized.
metric_definitions.settings: Ordered (key, value) tuples for setting actions match, on gold-setting commands only.

cases.text: Build eleven houses near the lake.
Plant a dozen flowers behind the tower.
Place a pair of rocks beside the river.
Add twelve orange cottages.
Build a house, then remove it.
cases.label_note: Within-command antecedent: it refers to the newly created house. Pronoun resolution is a documented limitation.

cases.text: Build a red house and a blue house, then put a tree between them.
cases.label_note: Them refers to the two newly created houses. This tests a documented capability gap.

cases.text: Plant five trees and then delete two of them.
cases.label_note: Them refers to the five newly created trees; remove two, not all five.

cases.text: Near the lake, plant four trees.
cases.label_note: Initial prepositional phrase modifies plant; lake is an existing landmark.

cases.text: To the left of the castle, build a tower.
Between the house and the tower, place a bridge.
Add a tree near the lake and a flower beside the castle.
Build three red houses and three blue towers.
cases.label_note: Color extraction is scored; tower material recoloring is a separate rendering limitation.

cases.text: Build one red and one blue house.
cases.label_note: One red [house] and one blue house: the omitted first noun denotes a separate house.

cases.text: Add three red houses and two blue flowers near the river.
cases.label_note: Use the documented local/nearest noun-phrase attachment convention for the final relation.
